title: Meta ads on Instagram (Reels and Stories placements)
description: Vertical video creatives for Meta ads shown in Instagram Reels and Stories. Mostly Meta Ads Guide recommendations (warnings); the 15-second limit is an observation, not a documented rule, so it warns too.

sources.title: Meta Business Help: Ads Guide, Instagram Reels video ads

notes: Observed (2026-10): ad videos longer than 15 seconds were not eligible for Instagram ad placements (the Marketing API reported is_instagram_eligible=false, and the same video cut to 14.8 seconds became eligible), although the Ads Guide lists up to 15 minutes for Reels ads. The rule only warns; use --strict, or set duration.severity to error in your own profile, to enforce it. If your placements accept longer videos, extend this profile and raise duration.max_s.
The Ads Guide also recommends keeping text and logos out of the top 14%, the bottom 35% and 6% at each side. This tool does not inspect picture content for that.

duration.note: Observed 2026-10; the Ads Guide lists up to 15 minutes for Reels ads, so this only warns.

video.size.note: The Ads Guide recommends 1440x2560; 1080x1920 is accepted as the common size.

audio.hiss.note: Observed 2026-10: a heuristic calibrated on game-trailer mixes, not a platform rule; see docs/checks.md#audiohiss.
